items.question: Trong câu "A Version Control System (VCS) is a system that tracks changes in code over time, allowing many people to work together and to roll back to previous versions.", từ "track" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Version Control System (VCS) is a system that tracks changes in code over time, allowing many people to work together and to roll back to previous versions.", what does "track" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: track /træk/ (động từ): theo dõi, ghi lại. "Track changes" = theo dõi và ghi lại các thay đổi. Nghĩa khác: lần theo dấu vết (track an animal).
items.explanationEn: track /træk/ (verb): to follow and record. "Track changes" means to keep a record of them. Other sense: to follow the marks left by an animal.

items.question: Trong câu "A Version Control System (VCS) is a system that tracks changes in code over time, allowing many people to work together and to roll back to previous versions.", từ "over time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Version Control System (VCS) is a system that tracks changes in code over time, allowing many people to work together and to roll back to previous versions.", what does "over time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: over time /ˌəʊ.və ˈtaɪm/ (cụm từ): theo thời gian. "Over time" = dần dần theo thời gian. Đừng nhầm với "overtime" (viết liền) = làm thêm giờ.
items.explanationEn: over time /ˌəʊ.və ˈtaɪm/ (phrase): gradually, as time passes. "Over time" means as time passes. Do not confuse it with "overtime" = extra working hours.

items.question: Trong câu "A Version Control System (VCS) is a system that tracks changes in code over time, allowing many people to work together and to roll back to previous versions.", từ "allow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Version Control System (VCS) is a system that tracks changes in code over time, allowing many people to work together and to roll back to previous versions.", what does "allow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allow /əˈlaʊ/ (động từ): cho phép, giúp có thể. "Allowing many people to work together" = cho phép nhiều người cùng làm việc. Cấu trúc: allow somebody to do something.
items.explanationEn: allow /əˈlaʊ/ (verb): to make possible. "Allowing many people to work together" means making it possible. Pattern: allow somebody to do something.

items.question: Trong câu "A Version Control System (VCS) is a system that tracks changes in code over time, allowing many people to work together and to roll back to previous versions.", từ "roll back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Version Control System (VCS) is a system that tracks changes in code over time, allowing many people to work together and to roll back to previous versions.", what does "roll back" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to return to an earlier state
items.explanation: roll back /ˌrəʊl ˈbæk/ (cụm từ): quay lại (bản cũ). "Roll back to a previous version" = quay về phiên bản trước khi có lỗi. Danh từ: a rollback.
items.explanationEn: roll back /ˌrəʊl ˈbæk/ (phrase): to return to an earlier state. "Roll back to a previous version" means to return to it after a problem. Noun: a rollback.

items.question: Trong câu "A Version Control System (VCS) is a system that tracks changes in code over time, allowing many people to work together and to roll back to previous versions.", từ "previous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Version Control System (VCS) is a system that tracks changes in code over time, allowing many people to work together and to roll back to previous versions.", what does "previous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: previous /ˈpriː.vi.əs/ (tính từ): trước đó. "Previous versions" = các phiên bản trước. Trái nghĩa: next, subsequent.
items.explanationEn: previous /ˈpriː.vi.əs/ (adjective): coming before. "Previous versions" are the earlier ones. Opposite: next, subsequent.

items.question: Trong câu "A Version Control System (VCS) is a system that tracks changes in code over time, allowing many people to work together and to roll back to previous versions.", từ "version" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Version Control System (VCS) is a system that tracks changes in code over time, allowing many people to work together and to roll back to previous versions.", what does "version" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: one form of something that changes
items.explanation: version /ˈvɜː.ʃən/ (danh từ): phiên bản. "Previous versions" = các phiên bản cũ của code. Nghĩa khác: lời kể của một người (her version of the story).
items.explanationEn: version /ˈvɜː.ʃən/ (noun): one form of something that changes. "Previous versions" are older forms of the code. Other sense: one person's account of events.

items.question: Trong câu "Git is the most popular VCS today (free and open source).", từ "open source" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Git is the most popular VCS today (free and open source).", what does "open source" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: open source /ˌəʊ.pən ˈsɔːs/ (cụm từ): mã nguồn mở. "Free and open source" = miễn phí và mã nguồn mở. Trái nghĩa: closed source / proprietary.
items.explanationEn: open source /ˌəʊ.pən ˈsɔːs/ (phrase): with code anyone can see. "Open source" software has code anyone can read and change. Opposite: closed source, proprietary.

items.question: Trong câu "To understand what developers are talking about in the daily standup.", từ "daily" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To understand what developers are talking about in the daily standup.", what does "daily" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: daily /ˈdeɪ.li/ (tính từ): hằng ngày. "Daily standup" = cuộc họp đứng hằng ngày. Danh từ "a daily" còn là tờ báo ra hằng ngày.
items.explanationEn: daily /ˈdeɪ.li/ (adjective): happening every day. "Daily standup" is a meeting held every day. As a noun, "a daily" is a daily newspaper.

items.question: Trong câu "To understand what developers are talking about in the daily standup.", từ "standup" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To understand what developers are talking about in the daily standup.", what does "standup" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: standup /ˈstænd.ʌp/ (danh từ): cuộc họp ngắn đầu ngày. "Daily standup" = cuộc họp nhanh (thường đứng) mỗi ngày. Nghĩa khác: stand-up comedy (hài độc thoại).
items.explanationEn: standup /ˈstænd.ʌp/ (noun): a short team meeting. "Daily standup" is a quick team meeting, often held standing. Other sense: stand-up comedy.

items.question: Trong câu "To read a pull request and review requirements.", từ "review" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To read a pull request and review requirements.", what does "review" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to study again for a test
items.explanation: review /rɪˈvjuː/ (động từ): xem xét, rà soát. "Review requirements / code" = rà soát yêu cầu / code. Nghĩa khác (AmE): ôn bài trước kỳ thi.
items.explanationEn: review /rɪˈvjuː/ (verb): to examine carefully. "Review requirements" means to examine them carefully. Other sense (AmE): to study again before a test.

items.question: Trong câu "To read a pull request and review requirements.", từ "requirement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To read a pull request and review requirements.", what does "requirement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪə.mənt/ (danh từ): yêu cầu (nghiệp vụ). "Review requirements" = rà soát các yêu cầu mà sản phẩm phải đáp ứng — việc chính của BA.
items.explanationEn: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪə.mənt/ (noun): something a product must do. "Requirements" are what the product must do; reviewing them is a core BA task.

items.question: Trong câu "To understand why merging is needed before a release.", từ "merge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To understand why merging is needed before a release.", what does "merge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (động từ): hợp nhất, gộp. "Merging" = gộp code từ nhánh này vào nhánh khác. Nghĩa khác: sáp nhập công ty (merger).
items.explanationEn: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (verb): to combine into one. "Merging" means combining code from one branch into another. Other sense: joining companies (a merger).

items.question: Trong câu "To understand why merging is needed before a release.", từ "release" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To understand why merging is needed before a release.", what does "release" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: release /rɪˈliːs/ (danh từ): bản phát hành. "Before a release" = trước khi phát hành phiên bản mới. Nghĩa khác: sự thả ra, press release (thông cáo báo chí).
items.explanationEn: release /rɪˈliːs/ (noun): a new version made public. "Before a release" means before a new version goes out. Other senses: setting free, a press release.

items.question: Trong câu "You don't need to know how to code, just the concepts.", từ "code" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You don't need to know how to code, just the concepts.", what does "code" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: code /kəʊd/ (động từ): viết mã, lập trình. "Know how to code" = biết lập trình. Danh từ "code" = mã nguồn; nghĩa khác: mật mã.
items.explanationEn: code /kəʊd/ (verb): to write software. "Know how to code" means able to write software. Noun "code" = source code; also a secret cipher.

items.question: Trong câu "You don't need to know how to code, just the concepts.", từ "concept" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You don't need to know how to code, just the concepts.", what does "concept" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: concept /ˈkɒn.sept/ (danh từ): khái niệm. "Just the concepts" = chỉ cần hiểu các khái niệm. Cụm: proof of concept (bản thử nghiệm ý tưởng).
items.explanationEn: concept /ˈkɒn.sept/ (noun): a general idea. "Just the concepts" means only the main ideas. Phrase: proof of concept.

items.question: Trong câu "A store of code together with its full change history.", từ "store" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A store of code together with its full change history.", what does "store" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a place where things are kept
items.explanation: store /stɔːr/ (danh từ): kho chứa. "A store of code" = kho chứa code. Nghĩa phổ biến khác: cửa hàng (a grocery store).
items.explanationEn: store /stɔːr/ (noun): a place where things are kept. "A store of code" is a place where code is kept. Common other sense: a shop.

items.question: Trong câu "A store of code together with its full change history.", từ "history" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A store of code together with its full change history.", what does "history" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: history /ˈhɪs.tər.i/ (danh từ): lịch sử (thay đổi). "Change history" = lịch sử thay đổi: ai sửa gì, lúc nào. Nghĩa khác: môn học lịch sử.
items.explanationEn: history /ˈhɪs.tər.i/ (noun): a record of past events. "Change history" is the record of who changed what and when. Other sense: the school subject.

items.question: Trong câu "of the code at a specific point in time, including:", từ "specific" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "of the code at a specific point in time, including:", what does "specific" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (tính từ): cụ thể, xác định. "At a specific point in time" = tại một thời điểm cụ thể. Trái nghĩa: general, vague.
items.explanationEn: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (adjective): clearly identified. "At a specific point in time" means at one exact moment. Opposite: general, vague.

items.question: Trong câu "A message describing the change.", từ "describe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A message describing the change.", what does "describe" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to say what something is like
items.explanation: describe /dɪˈskraɪb/ (động từ): mô tả. "A message describing the change" = thông điệp mô tả thay đổi. Danh từ: description.
items.explanationEn: describe /dɪˈskraɪb/ (verb): to say what something is like. "A message describing the change" explains what changed. Noun: description.

items.question: Trong câu "The author and a timestamp.", từ "author" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The author and a timestamp.", what does "author" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: author /ˈɔː.θər/ (danh từ): người tạo ra. "The author" của commit = người tạo ra commit đó. Nghĩa quen thuộc: tác giả, nhà văn.
items.explanationEn: author /ˈɔː.θər/ (noun): the person who created something. "The author" of a commit is the person who made it. Familiar sense: a writer of books.

items.question: Trong câu "The author and a timestamp.", từ "timestamp" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The author and a timestamp.", what does "timestamp" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a record of date and time
items.explanation: timestamp /ˈtaɪm.stæmp/ (danh từ): dấu thời gian. "A timestamp" = dấu thời gian ghi lại ngày giờ một sự kiện xảy ra.
items.explanationEn: timestamp /ˈtaɪm.stæmp/ (noun): a record of date and time. "A timestamp" records the exact date and time an event happened.

items.question: Trong câu "A unique hash (e.g., a1b2c3d).", từ "unique" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A unique hash (e.g., a1b2c3d).", what does "unique" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: the only one of its kind
items.explanation: unique /juˈniːk/ (tính từ): duy nhất, không trùng. "A unique hash" = mã băm duy nhất, không trùng với commit khác. Nghĩa khác: độc đáo, đặc biệt.
items.explanationEn: unique /juˈniːk/ (adjective): the only one of its kind. "A unique hash" is not shared with any other commit. Other sense: unusual, special.

items.question: Trong câu "A unique hash (e.g., a1b2c3d).", từ "hash" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A unique hash (e.g., a1b2c3d).", what does "hash" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hash /hæʃ/ (danh từ): mã băm. "A hash" = chuỗi mã được tính ra từ dữ liệu, dùng để nhận diện commit. Nghĩa khác: dấu # (hash sign), món băm.
items.explanationEn: hash /hæʃ/ (noun): a code made from data. "A hash" is a code computed from data that identifies a commit. Other senses: the # sign, a chopped-meat dish.

items.question: Trong câu "A branch is an independent line of development.", từ "independent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A branch is an independent line of development.", what does "independent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: independent /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt/ (tính từ): độc lập. "An independent line of development" = một hướng phát triển độc lập. Trái nghĩa: dependent.
items.explanationEn: independent /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt/ (adjective): not affected by others. "An independent line of development" runs without affecting others. Opposite: dependent.

items.question: Trong câu "A branch is an independent line of development.", từ "branch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A branch is an independent line of development.", what does "branch" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a separate line of code work
items.explanation: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (danh từ): nhánh (code). "A branch" = một nhánh code riêng. Nghĩa khác: cành cây, chi nhánh ngân hàng.
items.explanationEn: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (noun): a separate line of code work. "A branch" is a separate line of code work. Other senses: part of a tree, a local office of a bank.

items.question: Trong câu "It's like making a copy to experiment with without affecting the main version.", từ "experiment" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It's like making a copy to experiment with without affecting the main version.", what does "experiment" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: experiment /ɪkˈsper.ɪ.ment/ (động từ): thử nghiệm. "Experiment with something" = thử nghiệm với cái gì. Danh từ: an experiment (thí nghiệm).
items.explanationEn: experiment /ɪkˈsper.ɪ.ment/ (verb): to try new ideas. "Experiment with something" means to try it out. Noun: an experiment.

items.question: Trong câu "It's like making a copy to experiment with without affecting the main version.", từ "affect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It's like making a copy to experiment with without affecting the main version.", what does "affect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: affect /əˈfekt/ (động từ): ảnh hưởng đến. "Without affecting the main version" = không ảnh hưởng bản chính. Đừng nhầm: effect là danh từ.
items.explanationEn: affect /əˈfekt/ (verb): to have an effect on. "Without affecting the main version" means without changing it. Note: "effect" is the noun.

items.question: Trong câu "the main branch, usually the most stable code.", từ "stable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the main branch, usually the most stable code.", what does "stable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (tính từ): ổn định. "The most stable code" = code ổn định nhất, ít lỗi. Danh từ "stable" còn là chuồng ngựa.
items.explanationEn: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (adjective): unlikely to break. "The most stable code" is the least likely to break. As a noun, "stable" is a building for horses.

items.question: Trong câu "for an emergency fix.", từ "emergency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "for an emergency fix.", what does "emergency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: emergency /ɪˈmɜː.dʒən.si/ (danh từ): tình huống khẩn cấp. "An emergency fix" = bản sửa khẩn cấp (hotfix). Nghĩa khác (AmE): the emergency room = phòng cấp cứu.
items.explanationEn: emergency /ɪˈmɜː.dʒən.si/ (noun): a sudden serious situation. "An emergency fix" is an urgent repair (a hotfix). Related: the emergency room in a hospital.

items.question: Trong câu "for an emergency fix.", từ "fix" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "for an emergency fix.", what does "fix" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fix /fɪks/ (danh từ): bản sửa lỗi. "An emergency fix" = bản sửa lỗi gấp. Nghĩa khác: be in a fix = gặp rắc rối.
items.explanationEn: fix /fɪks/ (noun): a solution to a problem. "An emergency fix" is an urgent solution. Other sense: "in a fix" = in trouble.

items.question: Trong câu "Combining changes from one branch into another.", từ "combine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Combining changes from one branch into another.", what does "combine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: combine /kəmˈbaɪn/ (động từ): kết hợp, gộp lại. "Combining changes" = gộp các thay đổi lại — chính là merge. Danh từ: combination.
items.explanationEn: combine /kəmˈbaɪn/ (verb): to join together. "Combining changes" means joining them together — that is a merge. Noun: combination.

items.question: Trong câu "fetch the latest changes from the remote to local.", từ "latest" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "fetch the latest changes from the remote to local.", what does "latest" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: latest /ˈleɪ.tɪst/ (tính từ): mới nhất. "The latest changes" = các thay đổi mới nhất. Cụm: at the latest = muộn nhất là.
items.explanationEn: latest /ˈleɪ.tɪst/ (adjective): most recent. "The latest changes" are the most recent ones. Phrase: "at the latest" = no later than.

items.question: Trong câu "Creating a local copy of a remote repo.", từ "remote" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Creating a local copy of a remote repo.", what does "remote" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: remote /rɪˈməʊt/ (tính từ): từ xa (trên máy chủ). "A remote repo" = kho code nằm trên máy chủ. Nghĩa khác: vùng hẻo lánh; remote work = làm việc từ xa.
items.explanationEn: remote /rɪˈməʊt/ (adjective): located on another machine. "A remote repo" lives on a server. Other sense: far from towns; "remote work" = working from home.

items.question: Trong câu "Creating a local copy of a remote repo.", từ "local" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Creating a local copy of a remote repo.", what does "local" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: local /ˈləʊ.kəl/ (tính từ): trên máy cục bộ. "A local copy" = bản sao trên máy của bạn. Nghĩa khác: thuộc địa phương (local shop).
items.explanationEn: local /ˈləʊ.kəl/ (adjective): on your own computer. "A local copy" is on your own computer. Other sense: of a nearby area, as in "a local shop".

items.question: Trong câu "Creating a local copy of a remote repo.", từ "copy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Creating a local copy of a remote repo.", what does "copy" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a thing made the same as another
items.explanation: copy /ˈkɒp.i/ (danh từ): bản sao. "A local copy" = bản sao trên máy. Nghĩa khác: một cuốn sách (a copy of the book), nội dung quảng cáo (copywriting).
items.explanationEn: copy /ˈkɒp.i/ (noun): a thing made the same as another. "A local copy" is a duplicate on your machine. Other senses: one book or magazine, advertising text.

items.question: Trong câu "A Pull Request is a request to merge code from a feature branch into the main branch — accompanied by a code review.", từ "accompany" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Pull Request is a request to merge code from a feature branch into the main branch — accompanied by a code review.", what does "accompany" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to play music for a singer
items.explanation: accompany /əˈkʌm.pə.ni/ (động từ): đi kèm với. "Accompanied by a code review" = đi kèm với việc review code. Nghĩa khác: đệm đàn cho ca sĩ.
items.explanationEn: accompany /əˈkʌm.pə.ni/ (verb): to come together with. "Accompanied by a code review" means a review comes with it. Other sense: to play music for a singer.

items.question: Trong câu "BAs can take part: reviewing the PR for business logic and checking whether the AC is implemented correctly.", từ "take part" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BAs can take part: reviewing the PR for business logic and checking whether the AC is implemented correctly.", what does "take part" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: take part /ˌteɪk ˈpɑːt/ (cụm từ): tham gia. "Take part (in something)" = tham gia vào việc gì. Đừng nhầm "take sides" = đứng về một phía.
items.explanationEn: take part /ˌteɪk ˈpɑːt/ (phrase): to join in an activity. "Take part (in something)" means to join in. Do not confuse with "take sides" = support one side.

items.question: Trong câu "BAs can take part: reviewing the PR for business logic and checking whether the AC is implemented correctly.", từ "implement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BAs can take part: reviewing the PR for business logic and checking whether the AC is implemented correctly.", what does "implement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (động từ): triển khai, hiện thực hóa. "Is implemented correctly" = được hiện thực hóa đúng. Danh từ "implement" /ˈɪm.plɪ.mənt/ = dụng cụ.
items.explanationEn: implement /ˈɪm.plɪ.ment/ (verb): to put into effect. "Is implemented correctly" means built as specified. The noun "implement" means a tool.

items.question: Trong câu "BAs can take part: reviewing the PR for business logic and checking whether the AC is implemented correctly.", từ "whether" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BAs can take part: reviewing the PR for business logic and checking whether the AC is implemented correctly.", what does "whether" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: whether /ˈweð.ər/ (liên từ): liệu có... hay không. "Checking whether..." = kiểm tra xem có... hay không. Đồng âm với weather (thời tiết).
items.explanationEn: whether /ˈweð.ər/ (conjunction): if or not. "Checking whether..." means checking if something is true or not. Sounds like "weather".

items.question: Trong câu "download the repo", từ "download" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "download the repo", what does "download" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: download /ˌdaʊnˈləʊd/ (động từ): tải xuống. "Download the repo" = tải kho code về máy. Trái nghĩa: upload.
items.explanationEn: download /ˌdaʊnˈləʊd/ (verb): to copy from a server. "Download the repo" means to copy it to your machine. Opposite: upload.

items.question: Trong câu "fetch the latest changes", từ "fetch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "fetch the latest changes", what does "fetch" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: fetch /fetʃ/ (động từ): lấy về. "Fetch the latest changes" = lấy các thay đổi mới nhất về. Nghĩa khác: fetch a price = bán được giá.
items.explanationEn: fetch /fetʃ/ (verb): to get and bring back. "Fetch the latest changes" means to get them. Other sense: "fetch a price" = sell for that amount.

items.question: Trong câu "create and switch to a new branch", từ "switch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "create and switch to a new branch", what does "switch" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to turn a light on or off
items.explanation: switch /swɪtʃ/ (động từ): chuyển sang. "Switch to a branch" = chuyển sang làm việc trên nhánh đó. Cụm khác: switch on/off = bật/tắt.
items.explanationEn: switch /swɪtʃ/ (verb): to change to another. "Switch to a branch" means to move your work onto it. Other phrase: switch on/off.

items.question: Trong câu "stage changes", từ "stage" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "stage changes", what does "stage" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to prepare for the next step
items.explanation: stage /steɪdʒ/ (động từ): đưa vào vùng chờ. "Stage changes" = chọn thay đổi đưa vào vùng chờ trước khi commit. Nghĩa khác: dàn dựng vở kịch; danh từ: sân khấu, giai đoạn.
items.explanationEn: stage /steɪdʒ/ (verb): to prepare for the next step. "Stage changes" means to prepare them for the next commit. Other sense: to put on a play; noun: a phase.

items.question: Trong câu "save a snapshot", từ "snapshot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "save a snapshot", what does "snapshot" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɒt/ (danh từ): bản chụp trạng thái. "Save a snapshot" = lưu lại trạng thái code tại thời điểm đó. Nghĩa gốc: ảnh chụp nhanh.
items.explanationEn: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɒt/ (noun): a record of a moment. "Save a snapshot" means to record the code as it is at that moment. Original sense: a quick photo.

items.question: Trong câu "merge a branch into the current branch", từ "current" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "merge a branch into the current branch", what does "current" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: current /ˈkʌr.ənt/ (tính từ): hiện tại. "The current branch" = nhánh bạn đang đứng. Danh từ "current" = dòng nước, dòng điện.
items.explanationEn: current /ˈkʌr.ənt/ (adjective): happening now. "The current branch" is the one you are on now. Noun "current" = a flow of water or electricity.

items.question: Trong câu "view the commit history", từ "view" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "view the commit history", what does "view" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: view /vjuː/ (động từ): xem. "View the history" = xem lịch sử. Danh từ "view" = quang cảnh, quan điểm (in my view).
items.explanationEn: view /vjuː/ (verb): to look at. "View the history" means to look at it. Noun "view" = a scene, or an opinion ("in my view").

items.question: Trong câu "view the commit history", từ "commit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "view the commit history", what does "commit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (danh từ): lần lưu thay đổi. "Commit history" = danh sách các lần commit. Động từ commit nghĩa gốc: cam kết, phạm (commit a crime).
items.explanationEn: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (noun): a saved set of changes. "Commit history" lists saved change sets. The verb also means to promise, or to do a crime.

items.question: Trong câu "These are Git repository hosting platforms:", từ "repository" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are Git repository hosting platforms:", what does "repository" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: repository /rɪˈpɒz.ɪ.tər.i/ (danh từ): kho lưu trữ (code). "Git repository" = kho chứa code và lịch sử. Nghĩa rộng: nơi cất giữ đồ vật.
items.explanationEn: repository /rɪˈpɒz.ɪ.tər.i/ (noun): a central place storing code. "A Git repository" stores code and its history. General sense: a place where things are kept.

items.question: Trong câu "These are Git repository hosting platforms:", từ "host" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are Git repository hosting platforms:", what does "host" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: host /həʊst/ (động từ): lưu trữ trên máy chủ. "Hosting platforms" = nền tảng lưu trữ trực tuyến. Nghĩa khác: đăng cai (host the Olympics), dẫn chương trình.
items.explanationEn: host /həʊst/ (verb): to keep on a server. "Hosting platforms" keep your repos on their servers. Other senses: to hold an event, to present a show.

items.question: Trong câu "These are Git repository hosting platforms:", từ "platform" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are Git repository hosting platforms:", what does "platform" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: platform /ˈplæt.fɔːm/ (danh từ): nền tảng (dịch vụ). "Hosting platforms" = các nền tảng lưu trữ. Nghĩa khác: sân ga, bục, cương lĩnh của đảng.
items.explanationEn: platform /ˈplæt.fɔːm/ (noun): a service people build on. "Hosting platforms" are online services. Other senses: a train station area, a raised stage, a political program.

items.question: Trong câu "The most popular, with a large community", từ "popular" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most popular, with a large community", what does "popular" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: popular /ˈpɒp.jə.lər/ (tính từ): được ưa chuộng. "The most popular" = được nhiều người dùng nhất. Nghĩa khác: bình dân (popular culture).
items.explanationEn: popular /ˈpɒp.jə.lər/ (adjective): liked by many people. "The most popular" is used by the most people. Other sense: of ordinary people ("popular culture").

items.question: Trong câu "The most popular, with a large community", từ "community" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most popular, with a large community", what does "community" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: community /kəˈmjuː.nə.ti/ (danh từ): cộng đồng. "A large community" = cộng đồng người dùng đông đảo, dễ tìm trợ giúp. Nghĩa khác: khu dân cư.
items.explanationEn: community /kəˈmjuː.nə.ti/ (noun): a group sharing interests. "A large community" means many users to help each other. Other sense: people living in one area.

items.question: Trong câu "Integrated CI/CD, self-hosted", từ "integrated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Integrated CI/CD, self-hosted", what does "integrated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: integrated /ˈɪn.tɪ.ɡreɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): tích hợp sẵn. "Integrated CI/CD" = có sẵn CI/CD bên trong, không cần công cụ riêng. Nghĩa khác: hòa nhập (an integrated school).
items.explanationEn: integrated /ˈɪn.tɪ.ɡreɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): built in as a part. "Integrated CI/CD" is built in, with no separate tool. Other sense: mixed, as in "an integrated school".

items.question: Trong câu "Integrated CI/CD, self-hosted", từ "self-hosted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Integrated CI/CD, self-hosted", what does "self-hosted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: self-hosted /ˌself ˈhəʊ.stɪd/ (tính từ): tự lưu trữ (máy chủ riêng). "Self-hosted" = công ty tự cài trên máy chủ của mình thay vì dùng bản cloud.
items.explanationEn: self-hosted /ˌself ˈhəʊ.stɪd/ (adjective): run on your own servers. "Self-hosted" means a company runs it on its own servers instead of the cloud version.

items.question: Trong câu "Integrates well with Jira (Atlassian)", từ "integrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Integrates well with Jira (Atlassian)", what does "integrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: integrate /ˈɪn.tɪ.ɡreɪt/ (động từ): kết nối, tích hợp. "Integrates well with Jira" = kết nối tốt với Jira. Cấu trúc: integrate with something.
items.explanationEn: integrate /ˈɪn.tɪ.ɡreɪt/ (verb): to work together with. "Integrates well with Jira" means it works smoothly with Jira. Pattern: integrate with something.

items.question: Trong câu "an independent line of development.", từ "line" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an independent line of development.", what does "line" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: line /laɪn/ (danh từ): hướng, dòng (phát triển). "A line of development" = một hướng phát triển riêng. Nghĩa khác: dòng chữ, hàng người, đường kẻ.
items.explanationEn: line /laɪn/ (noun): a course of work. "A line of development" is one course of work. Other senses: a row of text, a queue, a drawn mark.

items.question: Trong câu "an independent line of development.", từ "development" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an independent line of development.", what does "development" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: development /dɪˈvel.əp.mənt/ (danh từ): sự phát triển (phần mềm). "Line of development" = hướng phát triển phần mềm. Nghĩa khác: diễn biến mới (a new development), khu nhà mới.
items.explanationEn: development /dɪˈvel.əp.mənt/ (noun): the building of software. "Development" here is building software. Other senses: a new event, a new housing area.

items.question: Trong câu "a snapshot of the code at a point in time.", từ "point in time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a snapshot of the code at a point in time.", what does "point in time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: point in time /ˌpɔɪnt ɪn ˈtaɪm/ (cụm từ): một thời điểm. "At a point in time" = tại một thời điểm nhất định. Cụm: at this point in time = vào lúc này.
items.explanationEn: point in time /ˌpɔɪnt ɪn ˈtaɪm/ (phrase): a particular moment. "At a point in time" means at a particular moment. Phrase: "at this point in time" = now.

items.question: Trong câu "the stable branch, usually = production.", từ "stable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the stable branch, usually = production.", what does "stable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (tính từ): ổn định. "The stable branch" = nhánh ổn định, thường chính là bản đang chạy thật. Danh từ: stability.
items.explanationEn: stable /ˈsteɪ.bəl/ (adjective): steady and reliable. "The stable branch" is the reliable one, usually what runs in production. Noun: stability.

items.question: Trong câu "platforms for storing and collaborating.", từ "collaborate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "platforms for storing and collaborating.", what does "collaborate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: collaborate /kəˈlæb.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): cộng tác. "Storing and collaborating" = lưu trữ và cộng tác. Nghĩa khác (tiêu cực): cộng tác với kẻ thù. Danh từ: collaboration.
items.explanationEn: collaborate /kəˈlæb.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to work together. "Storing and collaborating" means keeping code and working together. Negative sense: helping an enemy.
